classifiedFinding.title: setDesiredAPY commit is mempool-visible; stakers front-run to capture rate-change delta

symbolic: SYMBOLIC-005 PASS — confirms the gate is delay-only, providing no MEV protection (positive proof)

classification.assetImpact: Sophisticated mempool-watching stakers capture a disproportionate share of post-commit accrual at the expense of passive stakers. No direct fund theft.
attackPath: 2. MEV bot front-runs with stake(big_amount); debt anchors at OLD acc.
3. Commit tx lands; new rate applies prospectively.
4. Bot accrues at higher rate; eventually claims + withdraws.
classification.likelihood: high when honest owner changes APY; rational MEV behavior
classification.assumptions: Public mempool; APY rate changes occur

classifiedFinding.justification: Profile flags this as standard front-running of admin actions. Per C4 conventions, generic MEV / front-running of legitimate admin operations is QA. The two-step gate provides exactly the 100-block delay it advertises; the design intent failure ('gate should protect MEV') is a spec critique, not a vulnerability. Low/QA.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-medium. Classifier downgrades to Low because the surface is generic MEV / two-step-gate critique; remediation is private mempool for commit tx, which is operational guidance.
